name: wall-button-door
prompt: Make a door 0.9 m wide, 2 m tall and 0.05 m thick, hinged at its left edge, that swings open 90 degrees over a second. Next to it put a small 0.15 m square button on the wall. Clicking the button opens the door, and clicking it again closes the door.

name: two-switches-one-gate
prompt: Make a sliding gate panel 1.5 m wide, 1.2 m tall and 0.05 m thick that slides 1.5 m sideways over two seconds. Make two separate buttons, each 0.12 m square, placed apart from each other. Clicking either button slides the gate.

name: pressure-plate-bridge
prompt: Make a flat bridge plank 2 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.05 m thick that lowers 0.5 m over one second. Make a pressure plate, a 0.5 m square 0.03 m thick slab, which lowers the bridge plank when the viewer walks within 1.5 metres of the plate.
